actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It
can replace one attack with a use of Slowing Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10
+ 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: DC 14, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-footwide Line
actions.description: Failure: 40 (9d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: each creature in a 30-foot Cone
actions.description: Failure: The target can't take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.
